question.prompt: List three centrally symmetric figures. Which of the following groups consists of three centrally symmetric figures?

solutions.explanation: A parallelogram, a rectangle, and a circle each coincide with themselves after a \(180^\circ\) rotation about their center of symmetry. Equilateral triangles, isosceles triangles, and regular pentagons are not centrally symmetric figures.
solutions.title: Identify figures with half-turn symmetry
